capital_market_instruments.issuer_name: LAPO Microfinance Bank Limited (via LAPO MFB SPV PLC)
capital_market_instruments.series: Series 1 (of a NGN30bn Bond Issuance Programme)
capital_market_instruments.use_of_proceeds: Expanding financing opportunities for SMEs, improving access to renewable energy solutions, and strengthening delivery of digital financial services to MSMEs across Nigeria
capital_market_instruments.issuing_house: FirstCap Limited (Lead Sponsor); AVA Capital Partners Limited (Co-Sponsor)
capital_market_instruments.notes: An earlier Nairametrics article (2026-03-24) reported the offer being marketed up to NGN10bn with a 19-20% coupon range and an April 1, 2026 target close -- the FMDQ listing notice confirms only NGN4.46bn at 20.00% fixed actually listed as Series 1. Treat NGN10bn as the marketed ceiling, not the amount raised. No trustee named; unsecured -- no collateral/loan-portfolio security disclosed. Credit ratings per Nairametrics: BBB- (Agusto & Co.) / BBB- (GCR). Minimum subscription NGN20m; semi-annual coupon, bullet principal repayment.
